Kidney Stones

Ailment kidney-stones nephrolithiasis renal-calcification pain urinary-tract

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Hard deposits of minerals and salts that form inside the kidneys and can cause severe pain when passing through the urinary tract.

Symptoms

  • sudden severe flank pain
  • blood in urine
  • frequent urination
  • painful urination
  • nausea
  • vomiting
  • suprapubic pain

  • Corn Silk

  • Goldenrod

Affected Body Systems

  • renal
  • urinary
  • circulatory

Severity Levels

  • mild
  • moderate
  • severe
